body.x: This vacancy announcement pertains to law enforcement and/or governmental officials within INTERPOL's member countries only.
Please read the Conditions of Secondment in force at INTERPOL (shared via the NCB) including the maximum duration of secondment.

Please be aware that your home Administration/Agency/Service/Government will be responsible for all of your salary/remuneration, social insurance, pension contributions, welfare benefits, family allowances, benefits during your assignment at INTERPOL as well as travel, removal expenses related to your arrival at and departure from INTERPOL, and any other related costs depending on your circumstances. It is requested that you obtain in writing, confirmation from your home Administration/Agency/Service/Government that it agrees with these CONDITIONS OF SECONDMENT. This confirmation letter should be forwarded to us THROUGH THE NCB.

INTERPOL is the world’s largest international police organization, with 196 member states. Created in 1923, it facilitates cross-border police co-operation, and supports and assists all organizations, authorities, and services whose mission is to prevent or combat international crime. INTERPOL is now looking for a qualified candidate as a SECONDMENT Driver - RB Nairobi within the Nairobi Régional Bureau which is part of the Exec. Dir. Police Capabilities.
Job title: SECONDMENT Driver - RB Nairobi
Reporting To: Head of Regional Bureau

INTERPOL actively encourages applications from women and nationals of member countries that are currently unrepresented among our staff (please click on this link to access the list of countries). Candidates from these countries are particularly encouraged to apply.
INTERPOL’s recruitment process is merit-based hence all hiring decisions are made considering the applicant’s qualifications and the needs of the Organization.
INCLUDING GOALS AND OBJECTIVES OF THE POST

Reporting directly to the Head of Regional Bureau (RB)or Liaison office, the incumbent will be the driver to the Head of RB or Liaison office, responsible for ensuring the security, condition and maintenance of the official vehicle.

The incumbent will be at the disposition of the Head of RB or Liaison office in order to transport him/her, with a maximum of security, to all official engagements and in a professional capacity. The incumbent will also be responsible for ensuring that the official vehicle is maintained in excellent working condition at all times.
Act as the driver to the Head of the RB or Liaison office, strictly respecting defined itineraries, unless modifications need to be made for security reasons.
Under the direction of the Head of RB or Liaison office, drive the Head of RB or Liaison office to scheduled professional meetings and appointments.
All transport services are provided exclusively in support of the Head of RB's professional capacity and official duties. Any personal, private or family transportation are not in the scope.
Be responsible for planning routes and travel schedules, verifying the traffic situation and driving conditions and ensuring that an appropriate timeframe is allocated for travel to destination.
Be responsible for the maintenance, cleanliness and regular servicing of the official vehicle.
Ensure that the official vehicle is serviced on a regular basis and well maintained.
Ensure that the vehicle meets all the legal requirements in force in the country i.e. adheres to pollution regulations.
Inform the Head of RB or Liaison office of any mechanical problems with the official vehicle and propose solutions for the Head of RB or Liaison office’s consideration.
Provide the Head of RB or Liaison office with the necessary information regarding any repair work that may need to be carried out on the official vehicle.
As directed by the Head of RB or Liaison office, collect visitors to the RB or Liaison office from the airport and transfer them to their hotel.

As directed by the Head of RB or Liaison office, collect important visitors to the RB or Liaison office from the airport and transfer them to their hotel. In this respect, verify arrival times of flights and adapt accordingly to any eventual modifications in flight schedules.

Offer visitors he/she is accompanying any assistance they may require with their transportation, and be capable of providing them with basic information regarding the location of certain key services.
Be responsible for the security of the official vehicle at all times whilst on official duty.

Never leave the official vehicle unattended whilst on duty, and carry out a thorough security check of the vehicle. Ensure that all security measures are taken and/or in place before embarking on an official assignment.
Ensure that upon completion of his/her daily duties that the vehicle is returned to its official location when not in use.

Deliver official or urgent documents, collect official documents from administrations or government offices. May transfer RB or Liaison office personnel from one location to another in the context of their professional activities
Perform any other duties as instructed by the hierarchy.
Driving qualifications, preferably from a police training school, to drive all categories of vehicles.
A police security background or training is also required.
At least 1 year of experience in the area of security and driving within a police or similar international organization is required. A longer experience (e.g. 3 to 5 years) would be an asset.
Knowledge of any other language of the organization (Arabic, French or Spanish) would be an asset.
A high degree of flexibility is required, given the irregular hours for such a post.
A highly developed sense of observation in order to anticipate any potential problems.
Ability to react quickly as and when the need arises.
Ability to anticipate potential difficulties relating to security, traffic conditions etc.
As part of our commitment to transparency throughout our recruitment process, INTERPOL's Staff Manual Regulation 11.4: Age-limit, which states that:

'Officials of the Organization shall not normally be retained in service beyond the age of 65 years. The Secretary General may, in exceptional cases and in the interests of the Organization, extend this age limit, in which case he shall inform the official concerned sufficiently in advance.'

Given this Regulation and in case candidates reach the age of 65 during the potential duration of the appointment, should they be selected for the position and the process proceed to appointment, the employment period may be affected by this regulatory limit and may therefore not extend for the full standard contract duration as published in the vacancy notice.
We are sharing this information to ensure transparency at this stage of the process.
This position is no longer open.

We review listings for quality, but organizations may update or amend a posting at any time, so confirm the role and closing date on the organization’s official site before applying. No genuine employer charges a fee to apply, interview, or process an application — treat any request for payment as a scam. If a detail looks wrong or the posting seems fraudulent, report this job.
